messages:
Lina Morales: Heads-up: prod docsite link-check failed after yesterday's content sweep. Error shows a missing anchor `#realtime-inference` from /docs/overview.html.
Lina Morales: snippet: "Anchor not found: realtime-inference referenced from /docs/overview.html: line 214"
Omar Haddad: I think this is the heading slug change from when we added inline formatting. I changed 'Realtime inference (batching)' -> 'Realtime inference (`batching`)'. That likely changed the generated slug.
Tess Yoon: ah yep, inline code in headings changes slugification across docusaurus versions. Two fixes: update links to new slug OR pin a manual id on the heading with `{#realtime-inference}`.
Lina Morales: Which is less invasive? We have a lot of cross-doc links to that anchor.
Omar Haddad: Manual ids are safest. I'll open a small PR adding explicit IDs to the affected headings and run the link-checker job.
Tess Yoon: also scan for weird whitespace — I found a non-breaking space in a migration guide recently that produced `%C2%A0` in anchors. Could be a second issue.
Lina Morales: good catch. Omar can you run `rg "#realtime|%C2" -n docs` before the PR?
Omar Haddad: done. Found 2 occurrences: docs/overview.md (old link) and docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md (NBSP in heading).
Omar Haddad: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1002 — adds explicit {#realtime-inference} to the heading and normalizes whitespace in migration file. Includes an added CI step: markdown-link-check after build.
docs-bot: label added: docs-review. reviewers requested: Lina Morales, Tess Yoon.
Lina Morales: quick review: LGTM, please remove a stray trailing space in the heading id line.
Tess Yoon: can we also add a CONTRIBUTING note to avoid inline code in headings or require manual ids? Small paragraph is fine.
Omar Haddad: added CONTRIBUTING blurb and squashed commits.
ci-bot: running docs CI for PR 1002...
ci-bot: \u2714 build succeeded, \u2714 markdown link-check passed.
docs-bot: PR #1002 merged by Omar Haddad.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: deploy/docs-prod succeeded (build 410).
Lina Morales: Verified the anchor on prod, and migration guide link no longer 404s. Thanks!
Tess Yoon: follow-up issue filed to add a pre-commit hook for NBSP detection: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/217
Omar Haddad: closing thread.
